PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   C. Input Cable Tester

   C. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
